mars_water.title: Follow the lost water
mars_water.question: Which Algerian setting can help investigate an ancient river-to-lake system like Jezero's?

delay.label: about 11 min one way (197.5 million km on 14 Nov 2026)

specs.label: Landform
specs.value: Delta fan with a feeder channel

rules.Terrain & slope: Mean slope: 5° or less = 3, 10° or less = 2, 15° or less = 1, else 0.
rules.Surface materials: River, lake or evaporite sediments = 3, water-carved sandstone = 2, volcanic or crystalline rock = 0.
rules.Dryness: Annual rain (NASA POWER): under 20 mm = 3, under 50 = 2, under 100 = 1, else 0.
rules.Subsurface structures: Share of the box where L-band is brighter than the surface predicts (radar surprise z > 2, our ML model). Best site = 3, others scaled.
rules.Temperature extremes: Average monthly swing (T2M_MAX - T2M_MIN) of 15 °C or more = 2, else 1. Capped at 2: no Earth site reaches Mars or Moon extremes.
rules.Access for operations: Hub under 250 km straight-line, then share of box under 15°: over 90 % = 3, over 75 % = 2, else 1. Hub 250 km or more = 0.

mars_water.weighting: Terrain & slope and Surface materials count double (they define the analogy); the other four axes count once. Maximum 24.

mars_layers.title: Read the layered rocks
mars_layers.question: Which Algerian setting can rehearse a rover climbing through layered sedimentary rock, like Curiosity at Mount Sharp?

delay.label: about 11 min one way (197.5 million km on 14 Nov 2026)

planet_target.name: Gale Crater, base of Mount Sharp

specs.label: Slope
specs.value: Gentle crater floor rising onto the mound's lower slopes

specs.label: Landform
specs.value: A mound about 5 km high whose flanks expose hundreds of rock layers

specs.label: Surface cover
specs.value: Finely laminated mudstones laid down in ancient lakes

specs.label: Dryness
specs.value: Hyper-arid today; the rocks record long-lived lakes

rules.Terrain & slope: One point each for: relief 100 to 600 m, mean slope 3 to 12°, under 25 % of the box steeper than 15°.
rules.Surface materials: Thick layered sedimentary rock exposed = 3, layered sediments with little exposure = 2, volcanic or crystalline = 0.
rules.Dryness: Annual rain (NASA POWER): under 20 mm = 3, under 50 = 2, under 100 = 1, else 0.
rules.Subsurface structures: Share of the box where L-band is brighter than the surface predicts (radar surprise z > 2, our ML model). Best site = 3, others scaled.
rules.Temperature extremes: Average monthly swing (T2M_MAX - T2M_MIN) of 15 °C or more = 2, else 1. Capped at 2: no Earth site reaches Mars or Moon extremes.
rules.Access for operations: Hub under 250 km straight-line, then share of box under 15°: over 90 % = 3, over 75 % = 2, else 1. Hub 250 km or more = 0.

mars_layers.weighting: Terrain & slope and Surface materials count double (they define the analogy); the other four axes count once. Maximum 24.

candidates.verdict_reason: Scored 16/24: at least 50% of the target, but not the highest.
